api.snapshot(): Returns serializable real state, checks, counters, errors, seed, camera and configuration URL.
api.control(key, value): Validated setting; ranges clamp, invalid types/options throw. Allowed keys are in snapshot.controls. props.geometryDetail reconstructs the document while preserving controls/camera: wait for navigation then readiness again.
api.action(id): Triggers an actual shared game implementation. In paused mode advances two fixed steps so a visible response can be inspected.
api.pause(boolean): Stops simulation time; orbit, controls and rendering remain usable.
api.step(frames): Pauses and advances 1..1800 steps, each exactly 1/60 second, then renders.
api.reset(): Reloads the current module with the same seed and default parameters. Wait for readiness again.
api.select(moduleId): Navigates to another isolated module document and disposes the previous context on pagehide. Wait for readiness again.

reproducibility.simulation: Seeded scoped RNG, fixed simulation step; auto exposure and adaptive resolution disabled in lab.
reproducibility.controls: The copied URL preserves controls, seed, quality and exact orbit camera. A paused or shot observation also saves current simulation time, capped at 30 seconds of startup pre-roll. snapshot.urlTimeClamped is true beyond that limit; replay longer action/step sequences explicitly.
reproducibility.scope: A snapshot is an observation and configuration, not a complete transient-event replay. To reproduce impacts, deaths or ongoing animation, replay the same action/step sequence after reset.
reproducibility.imageComparison: Use the same browser, viewport, deviceScaleFactor and quality. GPU/driver differences can change pixel results; do not require cross-device bit identity.
reproducibility.audio: Real Web Audio requires a user gesture. Use OfflineAudioContext signal tests for automated audio assertions; a screenshot cannot verify sound.

outputs.referencePolicy: Original HTML, extracted fragments and reference screenshots stay local and untracked.

materialChannels.oxide: ORM A for schema 2; zero otherwise
